entries.reason: Placement validation and restore are visible gameplay system surfaces and document their world/query authority.
evidence: docs/dev/重构代码质量与系统完整性规范.md
entries.entity_scope: PlacementWorld cells and placement queries supplied by the building module owner.
entries.view: Caller-provided PlacementWorld snapshot plus generation-independent placement query value.
entries.read_set: PlacementWorld occupancy, PlacementQuery footprint, validator callbacks and placement snapshots.
entries.write_set: Placement result candidates and exact restore status; authoritative world mutation remains with the building owner.
entries.structural_changes: No ECS structural mutation inside validation; callers apply accepted placements through their own deferred mutation path.
entries.events: Validation failure reason and restore status are returned synchronously; no retained event callbacks.
entries.services: Injected ValidateFn callbacks and caller-owned world data; callbacks are invoked synchronously and not retained.
entries.phase: Placement admission or restore phase before authoritative building publication.
